reason_text.multi_value_cells: Cells hold several values (a test plan such as '0.17; 0.21; 0.25'), so there is no single value per test.
reason_text.no_condition_columns: The table has no oxygen or pressure column (it lists samples or notes, not test conditions).
reason_text.superseded: Every test in it is in PSI-39_Workbook table_CFI Data Summary.csv, which is built from the lab's own workbook, so it is not counted again.
reason_text.sparse_or_non_numeric: Most cells in the oxygen or pressure column are blank, approximate or not numbers.

tiers.A: Outcome-ready: single-valued conditions and a categorical outcome for every test.
tiers.B: Outcomes recorded: the table has measured results (burn time, spread rate…) but no mapped categorical outcome.
tiers.C: Conditions only: oxygen and pressure are mapped, no outcome.
tiers.D: Test plan: several values per cell, or a count of flames per test day. Not one row per test.
tiers.E: No oxygen or pressure: lists samples, notes or other variables.
tiers.S: Superseded: another table, built from the lab's own workbook, contains every test in this one.
